Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.controller.ClientController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientControllerInterface, ServerToClientInterface
public class ClientController extends Object implements ServerToClientInterface, ClientControllerInterface
ClientController is responsible for handling client-side interactions with the server, managing the client components, and processing events received from the server. It implements the ServerToClientInterface and ClientControllerInterface interfaces.
